{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u041/system/state/workspace/programs/task-821ffeff.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Fill each completely enclosed background region by area parity."""
    from collections import deque

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]

    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            if grid[sr][sc] != bg or seen[sr][sc]:
                continue
            q = deque([(sr, sc)])
            seen[sr][sc] = True
            cells = []
            touches_edge = False
            while q:
                r, c = q.popleft()
                cells.append((r, c))
                if r == 0 or c == 0 or r == h - 1 or c == w - 1:
                    touches_edge = True
                for dr, dc in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                    if (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w
                            and not seen[nr][nc] and grid[nr][nc] == bg):
                        seen[nr][nc] = True
                        q.append((nr, nc))
            if not touches_edge:
                fill = 7 if len(cells) % 2 else 2
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = fill
    return out
"
}
